title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
abstract: arXiv:2610.36100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). translated_title: CohortFlow：具有局部语义修正能力的可引导临床队列筛选智能体
translated_abstract: 面向临床队列筛选的语言模型智能体应能适应不断演变的入组标准，而无需重复处理未发生变化的要求。我们提出了CohortFlow，这是一种可引导的智能体，它将自然语言修正表示为对结构化队列规范的局部更新，并将其与一个持久的执行图进行协调。通过显式记录的语义依赖关系，系统能够选择性地使受影响的计算失效，同时保留有效的先前结果。在源自临床试验入组标准的100个场景（共包含126轮修正）上，使用相同的8B模型时，局部引导方法实现了77.0%的要求微平均F1分数，而完全重新生成方法为76.4%，这一微小的数值优势在统计上并不显著（p=0.493）。局部引导方法将完成后的平均修正延迟降低了64.8%，将执行过程中的平均修正延迟降低了44.3%，模型调用次数减少了38.1%。在另一项单独的概念验证评估中……
tldr: CohortFlow通过将自然语言修正转化为对结构化队列规范的局部更新，并借助显式语义依赖关系选择性失效受影响的计算，在保持与完全重新生成相当准确率的同时，将修正延迟降低最高64.8%、模型调用次数减少38.1%。
en_tdlr: CohortFlow is a steerable clinical cohort curation agent that represents natural-language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification, using explicit semantic dependencies to selectively invalidate affected computations, thereby reducing correction latency by up to 64.8% and model calls by 38.1% while maintaining accuracy comparable to full regeneration.
